en.name: SME Export Accelerator
en.description: A structured track for established companies seeking to sharpen their China export strategy with practical trade and market-entry support.
en.detailSubtitle: Ideal for companies that already know why China matters and now need a clearer pathway for channel validation and execution.
en.metaTitle: SME Export Accelerator | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Explore the SME Export Accelerator for companies refining their China export strategy.
en.overviewHtml: The SME Export Accelerator gives operators a cleaner path from export ambition to practical execution across partners, channels, and timeline decisions.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Companies with an existing product and commercial maturity.
  • Teams planning export, distributor, or e-commerce expansion into China.
  • Businesses that need strategic support before building a larger in-market footprint.
en.supportHtml:
• Market-entry advisory tailored to SME constraints and strengths.
  • Partner discovery support and application packaging.
  • Practical review on timing, sequencing, and channel priorities.
en.processHtml:
1. Apply with the standard competition form.
  2. Highlight current traction, export readiness, and objectives.
  3. Use the follow-up process to refine the final submission package.

br.name: SME Export Accelerator
br.description: Uma trilha estruturada para empresas estabelecidas que querem refinar sua estrategia de exportacao para a China com apoio pratico de comercio e entrada em mercado.
br.detailSubtitle: Ideal para empresas que ja sabem por que a China importa e agora precisam de um caminho mais claro para validar canais e executar.
br.metaTitle: SME Export Accelerator | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca o SME Export Accelerator para empresas refinando sua estrategia de exportacao para a China.
br.overviewHtml: O SME Export Accelerator oferece um caminho mais claro entre ambicao exportadora e execucao pratica em parceiros, canais e priorizacao de timing.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Empresas com produto existente e maturidade comercial.
  • Times planejando exportacao, distribuidor ou expansao por e-commerce na China.
  • Negocios que precisam de suporte estrategico antes de ampliar sua presenca local.
br.supportHtml:
• Assessoria de entrada em mercado adaptada a SMEs.
  • Apoio para mapear parceiros e empacotar a candidatura.
  • Revisao pratica sobre timing, sequenciamento e prioridades de canal.
br.processHtml:
1. Aplique pelo formulario padrao.
  2. Destaque tracao atual, prontidao de exportacao e objetivos.
  3. Use o follow-up para refinar a submissao final.

cn.name: SME Export Accelerator
cn.description: 面向成熟企业的结构化项目，帮助团队更清晰地制定对华出口与市场进入策略。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合已经明确中国机会、现在需要更清晰渠道验证与执行路径的公司。
cn.metaTitle: SME Export Accelerator | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 SME Export Accelerator，适合优化对华出口策略的企业。
cn.overviewHtml: SME Export Accelerator 帮助企业把出口意图转化为更可执行的伙伴、渠道和时间规划方案。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 拥有现有产品和商业成熟度的公司。
  • 计划通过出口、分销商或电商进入中国市场的团队。
  • 在扩大本地布局前需要策略支持的企业。
cn.supportHtml:
• 适合中小企业节奏的市场进入咨询。
  • 伙伴发现与申请材料整理支持。
  • 关于时机、顺序和渠道优先级的实操建议。
cn.processHtml:
1. 通过统一申请表提交。
  2. 突出当前牵引力、出口准备度和目标。
  3. 在跟进过程中完善最终提交材料。
